title: Australian Frittata
description: A hearty Australian-inspired frittata packed with onion and a twist of Aussie flavors.

ingredients.name: Australian eggs
ingredients.notes: Fresh eggs for a moist frittata

instructions: In a large skillet, sauté onion over medium heat until softened.
Add diced jewel-toned bell pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Pour whisked eggs over the skillet mixture.
Transfer skillet to preheated oven and bake for 18-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from oven and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
